tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the core purpose of open-notebook: an AI-powered notebook interface that builds episodic memory, semantic index, and interactive features like quiz generation from your notes and uploads.

tour.title: Infrastructure Orchestration
tour.description: Understand how the backend API, the SurrealDB database, and the frontend web app are containerized, configured, and run together locally in development and production environments.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds separate build environments from slim runtime environments to decrease image size.

tour.title: API Entry & Authentication
tour.description: Examine how the FastAPI backend bootstraps, initializes CORS/security middlewares, registers routers, and protects sensitive endpoints using API password validation.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI uses middleware class declarations to intercept requests globally and route handlers for specific path operations.

tour.title: Database Access & SurrealDB Integration
tour.description: Examine the SurrealDB repository layer which connects the application to database records, handles raw SurrealQL query execution, and enforces relation-level schemas.
tour.languageLesson: SurrealDB uses records IDs in table:id format. Repository methods wrap connection pools to abstract database queries.

tour.title: Domain Models
tour.description: Learn about the core notebook structures—such as Notebook, Asset, Source, Note, and ChatSession—and how user credentials map to domain entities.
tour.languageLesson: Pydantic models in Python enforce runtime type validation and serialize domain objects cleanly to and from JSON.

tour.title: AI Models & Key Provisioning
tour.description: Trace how API keys are provisioned for various providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama) and how models are discovered, registered, and managed.
tour.languageLesson: Model managers cache API provider capabilities and dynamically test keys to prevent runtime LLM execution failures.

tour.title: Semantic Index & Chat Services
tour.description: Explore how open-notebook constructs conversational agents, performs vector search, processes file embeddings, and generates notebook insights.

tour.title: Interactive Quiz & LangGraph Flows
tour.description: Dive into the LangGraph state machine that drives the interactive quiz generation flow, validating and repairing JSON schemas dynamically.
tour.languageLesson: LangGraph uses a state graph where nodes represent computational steps and edges define conditional routing based on state updates.

tour.title: Next.js Web Frontend
tour.description: Explore the Next.js page layout and root entry point which renders the premium user interface, managing active sessions and workspace views.
tour.languageLesson: Next.js App Router uses file-system based routing where layout.tsx wraps page.tsx to share common layouts.
